{{Top|leg}}
The '''Bestinians''' were the [[Human/Legends|Human]] natives of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bestine IV/Legends|Bestine IV]] and the wider [[Bestine system/Legends|Bestine system]]. The Bestinians donated [[Starship/Legends|ships]] to the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] for the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].

One of the most notable of Bestinians was [[Jek Tono Porkins/Legends|Jek Tono Porkins]]<ref name="GG1">''[[Galaxy Guide 1: A New Hope]]''</ref> whom flew in [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] under the call sign of [[Red Six/Legends|Red Six]] at the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] against the first [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]].
